Otherwise only each app\'s name and how many. Whatever Android hides on the lock screen stays hidden.

Shows today\'s events, the weather and what is unread on the lock screen, from Calendar, Sky, Messaging and Email, and how many notifications the apps you choose have waiting. Without Calendar, it can read today\'s events itself if you turn that on. It reads the lock screen only to see where its own items end and whether the PIN pad is up, and it has no network access.

It shows what Calendar, Sky, Messaging and Email hand it, and only when their own settings allow. With notification access on, it counts the notifications of the apps you choose, and reads what they say only if you turn that on. Without Calendar, it reads today\'s events from Mudita\'s Calendar and, with calendar access, the phone\'s other calendars, only if you turn that on. It has no network access.
